title: Conservation law of the stationary cone for the rotation field of Q
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, R = (M, θ, ξ) ∈ IMRep(ℝ^P, 2) with μ := R.measure, Q a 2-dimensional linear subspace, a, e ∈ Q with |a| = |e| = 1 and ⟨a, e⟩ = 0, and 0 < s ≤ 1/4. Assume (i) R.firstVariation X = 0 for every C¹ compactly supported X : ℝ^P → ℝ^P; (ii) p_{T_x}(x) = x for μ-a.e. x (T_x := approxTangentPlane 2 M x); (iii) for μ-a.e. x with ⟨x, a⟩ > 0, ||x| − 1| < s and |f(x)| < s (f(x) := arctan(⟨x, e⟩/⟨x, a⟩)) one has |x − πx| < (s/2)|x| or 2s|x| < |x − πx| (π := Q.starProjection). Then for all ψ, l ∈ C¹(ℝ) with tsupport ψ ⊆ (−s, s) and tsupport l ⊆ (1 − s, 1 + s), the function x ↦ ψ'(f(x))·l(|x|)·G(x), G(x) := |p_{T_x}(Ax)|²/|πx|² with Ax := ⟨x, a⟩e − ⟨x, e⟩a, is μ-integrable on Z_s := {x : ⟨x, a⟩ > 0, ||x| − 1| < s, |f(x)| < s, |x − πx| < s|x|} and ∫_{Z_s} ψ'(f(x))·l(|x|)·G(x) dμ(x) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P) (s : ℝ), Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → a ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → 0 < s → s ≤ 1 / 4 → (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → R.firstVariation X = 0) → (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, (approxTangentPlane 2 R.carrier x).starProjection x = x) → (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, 0 < inner ℝ x a → |‖x‖ - 1| < s → |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| < s → ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s / 2 * ‖x‖ ∨ 2 * s * ‖x‖ < ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖) → ∀ ψ l : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → ContDiff ℝ 1 l → tsupport ψ ⊆ Ioo (-s) s → tsupport l ⊆ Ioo (1 - s) (1 + s) → IntegrableOn (fun x : Euclid P => deriv ψ (Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)) * l ‖x‖ * (‖(approxTangentPlane 2 R.carrier x).starProjection (inner ℝ x a • e - inner ℝ x e • a)‖ ^ 2 / ‖Q.starProjection x‖ ^ 2)) {x : Euclid P | 0 < inner ℝ x a ∧ |‖x‖ - 1| < s ∧ |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| < s ∧ ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s * ‖x‖} R.measure ∧ ∫ x in {x : Euclid P | 0 < inner ℝ x a ∧ |‖x‖ - 1| < s ∧ |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| < s ∧ ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s * ‖x‖}, deriv ψ (Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)) * l ‖x‖ * (‖(approxTangentPlane 2 R.carrier x).starProjection (inner ℝ x a • e - inner ℝ x e • a)‖ ^ 2 / ‖Q.starProjection x‖ ^ 2) ∂R.measure = 0
